instruction: Build a graph synonym index like my SQLite
scope: Build and query a separate SQLite graph from the existing synonym catalog format, with optional reviewed directed links and selector explanations.
validation: Ten focused graph, flat synonym index, and Dice Bag unit tests passed. The persisted graph reopened read-only with SQLite integrity checks passing and reproduced all 72 frozen Dice Bag lookup results.
limitations: Lookup gives suggestions for review, and the default reader still checks evidence through the existing path. The Dice Bag parity run kept the original vocabulary and measures no improvement in unfamiliar wording.
next_steps: Use a separately authored held-out catalog to evaluate added graph edges, ambiguity, and qualifier retention.
